manifest.name: Point of Sale - Coupons & Loyalty
manifest.summary: Use Coupons, Gift Cards and Loyalty programs in Point of Sale

behavioral_notes.element: pos.session._load_pos_data_models + loyalty.{program,rule,reward,card}._load_pos_data_* (program/reward catalog pushed into the offline terminal)
behavioral_notes.observation: pos.session._load_pos_data_models appends ['loyalty.program','loyalty.rule','loyalty.reward','loyalty.card'] to the data shipped into the OWL terminal at session start, so the whole promotions catalog is resolved server-side once and then evaluated client-side. Each model is _inherit=['<base>','pos.load.mixin'] and overrides _load_pos_data_domain to only the programs returned by pos.config._get_program_ids() -- which filters loyalty.program on pos_ok=True, the date window, this config (or no config => all configs), a matching pricelist and currency, and not over max_usage. loyalty.rule._compute_valid_product_ids precomputes valid_product_ids (intersected with available_in_pos=True) plus an any_product flag per rule so the JS never runs a product domain live; loyalty.reward._load_pos_data_read rewrites reward_product_domain replacing ilike with in (resolving display-name searches to id lists) because the POS client cannot run ilike. loyalty.card loads with domain False (no cards prefetched) -- cards are fetched on demand by partner/code. None of this load-shaping is visible in field metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: pos.order.confirm_coupon_programs (server write-back of points & coupons after the JS computes them)
behavioral_notes.observation: After the paid order is created, the client calls pos.order.confirm_coupon_programs(coupon_data) with the per-coupon point deltas it computed offline. The server (sudo, since POS users lack create rights) CREATES the loyalty.card records the order awarded (code = supplied/barcode or _generate_code(), points 0, source_pos_order_id=self, expiration_date), maps the client's negative placeholder ids to the real db ids, then for pre-existing nominative cards does coupon.points += delta and links each reward order line to its coupon via reward_identifier_code. It fires new_coupons._send_creation_communication() (the at-creation loyalty.mail / e-receipt) and renders any gift-card pos_report_print_id PDF. It returns coupon_updates (new id+balance), program_updates (total_order_count) and new_coupon_info so the client can swap its placeholder ids and refresh balances. _check_existing_loyalty_cards collapses a customer's loyalty/ewallet change onto their already-issued card; _process_existing_gift_cards top-ups an existing gift card and assigns partner/source order; _remove_duplicate_coupon_data guards against double-posting history if the order is re-synced.

behavioral_notes.element: pos.order.validate_coupon_programs + pos.config.use_coupon_code (checkout-time coupon / gift-card validation & redemption)
behavioral_notes.observation: Two server entry points guard redemption at the till. pos.config.use_coupon_code(code, ...) is the scan/enter-code path: it searches loyalty.card by code among this config's programs (allowing unowned gift cards), rejects on inactive program, expiry, program date window, max_usage, insufficient points for any reward, wrong pricelist, or a promo_code program, and on success returns program_id/coupon_id/points/has_source_order for the client to activate. pos.order.validate_coupon_programs(point_changes, new_codes) runs at order validation (OrderPaymentValidation): it re-reads every used loyalty.card, fails if any vanished/was deactivated (returning removed_coupons so the UI strips them), fails with the live balance if a card no longer has enough points (float_compare vs the negative spend), and fails if any new gift-card code already exists in the DB (perhaps already sold). loyalty.card.get_gift_card_status validates a fresh, unused, unowned, positive-balance gift card before sale. This server validation backstops the optimistic client math against concurrent use.

behavioral_notes.element: loyalty.card balance, loyalty.history ledger & loyalty.program.total_order_count over the POS lifecycle
behavioral_notes.observation: loyalty.card here adds source_pos_order_id (the originating till order) and overrides _has_source_order/_get_default_template/_get_signature so a POS-issued coupon e-mails the pos_loyalty.mail_coupon_template signed by the cashier. Point movement is journaled into loyalty.history: pos.order.add_loyalty_history_lines writes issued(won)/used(spent) rows keyed by (order_model='pos.order', order_id) for every coupon the order won or spent, and _process_existing_gift_cards writes its own history rows on top-up / partner-assign / order-assign. loyalty.card._compute_use_count and loyalty.program._compute_pos_order_count/_compute_total_order_count are overridden to count pos.order.line usage via a raw SQL LATERAL join over pos_order/pos_order_line.reward_id, so a program's usage cap and reporting include POS redemptions, not just sale orders. Balances persist on loyalty.card.points; there is no session-close batch -- the debit/credit is committed per order at confirm_coupon_programs.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (OWL/JS) -- the entire loyalty redemption ENGINE runs client-side in the offline POS terminal (gap #3, the headline)
behavioral_notes.observation: Almost all of pos_loyalty's behavior is JS/OWL injected into point_of_sale._assets_pos (13 JS / 6 XML), NOT Python: the point-earning, reward-claiming, discount-math and gift-card/eWallet logic is a ~1450-line patch on PosOrder plus a ~880-line patch on PosStore. PosOrder.pointsForPrograms() computes points per program from order lines (reward_point_mode order/money/unit, minimum_qty/amount, per-rule split for 'future' programs, round-half-up on money unlike sale_loyalty); getClaimableRewards()/_applyReward()/_getRewardLineValues{Discount,Product}() build the actual reward pos.order.lines (is_reward_line, reward_id, coupon_id, points_cost, reward_identifier_code -- the local extraFields on PosOrderline) for percent/per_order/per_point and order/cheapest/specific discounts and free-product (buy-X-get-Y via computeFreeQuantity) rewards; couponPointChanges{} on uiState is the offline ledger of points each program grants. PosStore.updateRewards()/updatePrograms() (mutex-guarded) re-evaluate after every line/partner/pricelist change and auto-apply single-reward programs; activateCode() scans promo/coupon/gift-card codes (calling use_coupon_code), ManageGiftCardPopup + ControlButtons drive gift-card sale and eWallet pay/refund, and postProcessLoyalty() assembles couponData and calls confirm_coupon_programs after sync. Coupons are created with negative placeholder ids offline and remapped to real db ids post-sync (couponByLineUuidCache). This whole optimistic, offline-first redemption model is reverse-engineerable only from the static JS.

it_architecture.application: pos_loyalty (Coupons & Loyalty extension of the Point of Sale application component: pushes the loyalty program/reward catalog into the offline OWL terminal and writes earned/redeemed points back onto pos.order)
software_services: (no own HTTP/JSON-RPC routes; exposes model RPC methods on the point_of_sale data layer: pos.config.use_coupon_code, pos.order.validate_coupon_programs, pos.order.confirm_coupon_programs, loyalty.card.get_gift_card_status / get_loyalty_card_partner_by_code)
logical_data_erm: loyalty.program -> pos.config (pos_config_ids, many2many; empty => all configs)
loyalty.card -> loyalty.history (issued/used rows keyed by pos.order)
information_flows: load: pos.session._load_pos_data_models ships loyalty.program/rule/reward/card into the terminal, scoped by pos.config._get_program_ids() (pos_ok, dates, config, pricelist, currency, usage cap)
client compute: the OWL PosOrder/PosStore patches earn points & build reward order lines entirely offline (couponPointChanges ledger)
checkout validation: client -> pos.config.use_coupon_code / pos.order.validate_coupon_programs guard coupon validity & balances against concurrent use
write-back: client -> pos.order.confirm_coupon_programs creates/updates loyalty.card, debits/credits points, writes loyalty.history, fires creation e-mail + gift-card report
downstream (inherited from point_of_sale): the discount/free-product reward lines land on pos.order -> account.move at session close; reward backing products come from the loyalty module
session-open guard: pos.config._check_before_creating_new_session validates reward products available_in_pos and well-formed gift-card programs

capabilities: Apply Coupons & Promo Codes at the Till
Earn & Redeem Loyalty Points on POS Orders
Sell & Redeem Gift Cards in Point of Sale
Top-up & Pay with eWallets at the Till
Apply Automatic & Code Promotions (discounts, buy-X-get-Y, free products)
Issue Coupons / Cards from a POS Order (with e-receipt & printed gift card)
Offline-First Reward Computation with Server Validation at Checkout
value_streams: POS promotion-to-redemption: load applicable programs into the till -> scan/auto-apply coupon, promo code, gift card or eWallet -> earn/spend points & add reward lines offline -> validate balances at payment -> tender -> confirm order writes back card points + loyalty.history + e-mails/prints the issued coupon
information_concepts: loyalty.card (coupon / loyalty card / gift card / eWallet, POS-sourced)
organization: point_of_sale.group_pos_user (cashier; operates redemption at the till)
products: product.product (reward discount_line_product_id / free-product backing service product, created by the loyalty module)
gift card & eWallet trigger products (program.trigger_product_ids, sold as POS lines)
policies: no own ir.rule (0 record rules); 13 ir.model.access rows extend access for the POS-loaded loyalty models, reusing point_of_sale groups

gift-card programs must have exactly one rule (1 point/currency) and one reward (1 currency/point, per_point discount), plus mail template + print report, or a session cannot open (_check_before_creating_new_session)
reward products must be available_in_pos before a session opens

a coupon/gift card is rejected at the till if expired, out of its date window, over max_usage, wrong pricelist, lacking points, or its code already exists in the DB (use_coupon_code / validate_coupon_programs)
POS users create coupons via sudo (no direct create right); duplicate history is suppressed on re-sync
stakeholders: Customer (res.partner) earning/redeeming points, holding the gift card / eWallet
POS / Marketing manager configuring programs and POS visibility
Accounting (reward discounts land on account.move at session close)
metrics: loyalty.program.pos_order_count / total_order_count (POS redemptions per program, via SQL over pos_order_line.reward_id)
loyalty.history issued/used ledger per card keyed by pos.order

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: pos_loyalty is the promotions/rewards layer of point_of_sale, which is itself a value-chain PRIMARY activity: the originating value-creating act is the retail sell/checkout that produces a paid pos.order and drives downstream deliver (stock.picking) and revenue/cash recognition (account.move at session close). Because this module's coupons, points, discounts and gift cards are applied inside that primary Sell/Deliver act -- they discount the cart, add reward lines to the live pos.order and move card balances at payment -- it inherits value_model 'chain' / activity_class 'primary', rather than the 'support' classification carried by the standalone loyalty engine (which alone confirms no transaction). It maps to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services: the promotion/loyalty redemption is the retail manage-promotions / sell-to-customer flow (3.2 manage promotions realized at the 3.5 point-of-sale order), with deliver (4.0) and AR/cash (9.0) remaining triggered side-effects inherited from the POS, not this module's mission. Note the strong frontend/'network' character: virtually the entire redemption engine ships as OWL screens patched into the offline, IndexedDB-backed POS terminal, with no server HTTP routes of its own -- but the value logic is chain.

standard_capabilities: apply coupons, discount/promo codes, automatic promotions, buy-X-get-Y and free-product rewards at the POS
earn and redeem loyalty points on POS orders (per order / per money / per unit), with creation & milestone e-receipts
sell gift cards (printed PDF + e-mail) and redeem them as payment in the till
top-up and pay with eWallets, including refund-to-eWallet
scan a gift-card / promo barcode (dedicated barcode.rule + promo_barcode) to activate a program
offline-first reward computation in the terminal with server-side validation of balances/codes at checkout
per-config program scoping (pos_config_ids; empty => all POS), pricelist and currency gating
POS usage feeds the program usage cap and loyalty.history reporting
typical_fits: retail promotions: % / fixed discounts, code campaigns, buy-X-get-Y, free gifts at the counter
store gift cards sold and redeemed at the till, printed and e-mailed
points-based loyalty for walk-in customers with a selected partner
a program limited to specific shops via pos_config_ids
common_gaps: bespoke earning/redemption math beyond the built-in point modes must be coded into the OWL PosOrder patch (the engine is client-side JS, not configuration)
tiered membership / status levels are not modeled natively
cross-channel real-time point sync with sale / website_sale relies on shared loyalty.card balances and is subject to the optimistic-offline race the server validation backstops
external loyalty-platform / CRM-points integration (no outbound HTTP/SDK here -- integrations gap #7 is empty)
gift-card program shape is tightly constrained (one rule / one reward, 1:1 point-currency) and rejected at session open otherwise
any new till reward interaction requires JS/OWL development, not back-office setup
drive_hints: odoo shell: env['pos.config'].browse(cfg.id).use_coupon_code(code, fields.Date.today(), partner_id, pricelist_id) to test a coupon
browse /pos/ui/<config_id>, add a product, open Rewards / Enter Code (ControlButtons) to apply a coupon or gift card live

open_questions: Exact offline point-earning/reward algorithm (pointsForPrograms / getClaimableRewards / _computeUnclaimedFreeProductQty) lives entirely in static/src JS; the per-program split, round-half-up money mode and free-quantity correction are reverse-engineerable only from that code, not Python.

Concurrency: how the optimistic client-side balance is reconciled against the server (validate_coupon_programs / confirm_coupon_programs) when the same nominative card is used on two terminals or in sale/website_sale at the same time.
Negative-placeholder coupon id remapping (couponByLineUuidCache / rewardProductByLineUuidCache) on order sync -- edge cases on re-sync and the _remove_duplicate_coupon_data guard.
Lifecycle of POS-issued gift cards vs eWallet expiration (program.date_to applied on confirm; loyalty cards barred from expiration upstream).
